test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 30 men can complete a work in 10 days. They started working and after six days, 10 more men joined them. In how many days will the total work be completed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining work after 6 days = **30 men × 4 days** = 120 man-days.

Total men after joining = 30 + 10 = **40 men**.

Days to finish remaining work = 120 ÷ 40 = **3 days**.

Total days = 6 (initial) + 3 (remaining) = **9 days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency (per man)**

 30 Men
 10
 300 units
 1 unit/day

**Given:** Initial men = 30, Initial days = 10, Men joined after 6 days = 10.

**Formula:** Total Work = Men × Days

⇒ Total Work = 30 × 10 = 300 units.

⇒ Work completed in 6 days = 30 × 6 = 180 units.

⇒ Remaining Work = 300 − 180 = 120 units.

⇒ Total men now = 30 + 10 = 40 men.

⇒ Days to complete remaining work = 120 ÷ 40 = 3 days.

⇒ Total days taken = 6 + 3 = 9 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Man-Days Formula

The total work is constant and expressed as M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂, where M is number of men and D is number of days.

Work and Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken. If the number of men increases, the time required to complete the same work decreases.

Chain Rule

For different work amounts: (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.</p
